subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these thirteen third-party GitHub Action pin upgrades in credential-bearing workflows after an owner verifies the action contracts and reviews redacted runtime evidence?
rationale: The patch changes externally supplied code at automation and secret boundaries; the repository policy requires a maintainer-level supplier-trust decision rather than inferring safety from Dependabot metadata or workflow linting.

options.title: Review and merge with runtime evidence
options.body: Verify the changed action contracts, confirm current workflow inputs remain supported, and merge after representative redacted runs demonstrate the affected workflows.

options.title: Pause this grouped update
options.body: Hold the broad dependency bump and land narrower owner-reviewed action upgrades if a supplier-contract review cannot be completed together.

recommendation.title: Review and merge with runtime evidence
recommendation.body: Verify the changed action contracts, confirm current workflow inputs remain supported, and merge after representative redacted runs demonstrate the affected workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only evidence-backed routing signal available from the supplied PR history, though a human workflow/security owner must make the decision.
